components.name: Lakehouse//RT
components.description: A read-only serverless warehouse type for low-latency, high-concurrency serving, powered by the Reyden engine. It answers SELECT queries in about 10 ms on smaller datasets and under 100 ms on larger ones, holding sub-100 ms at 12,000 queries per second and tens of thousands of concurrent users and agents. It reads governed Delta and Iceberg managed tables, materialized views, streaming tables and metric views directly in Unity Catalog, so operational analytics, customer-facing apps and agent serving no longer need a separate real-time database with its own CDC pipelines and permissions.

industries.label: Advertising
industries.blurb: Media buying, campaign delivery, audience targeting, brand safety, and cross-channel attribution across linear, digital, and retail media.

Bronze.s: Raw ad server and partner logs
Bronze.long: Impression, click, conversion and spend events from DSPs, ad servers and clean rooms, landed exactly as received so a bid or a view can be replayed for audit.

Silver.long: Campaigns, line items, creatives and audience segments resolved into single entities across platforms, with identity graphs stitched and frequency caps reconciled.

Gold.long: Contracted products the media and finance teams run on: ROAS and CPA by channel, incremental lift, reach and frequency, and brand safety incident rates.

industries.label: Aerospace & Space
industries.blurb: Aerospace OEMs, satellite operators and launch providers: PLM and the digital thread, MES and supply chain, MRO and fleet reliability, satellite telemetry, mission ops and earned-value program control.

Bronze.long: CATIA and Teamcenter change orders, Opcenter and Apriso lot and process records, CCSDS satellite telemetry and ground downlink, engine and test-stand streams, Deltek cost and schedule actuals, landed exactly as received so a design change or a telemetry pass can be replayed as it stood.

Silver.long: Programs, parts, serial numbers, satellites and engines resolved into single conformed entities across PLM, MES, MRO and mission systems, with the as-designed, as-planned and as-built configurations reconciled and every serial stitched from component to flight.

Gold.long: Contracted products the program and operations teams run on: earned-value cost and schedule variance by control account, first-pass yield and OEE by line, satellite and fleet reliability by vehicle, and anomaly and removal rates by subsystem.

industries.label: Agriculture
industries.blurb: Farm operations, crop planning, input supply, commodity trading, and sustainability reporting across grower networks and co-ops.

Bronze.long: Telemetry from equipment, weather stations, satellite imagery and exchange ticks, landed exactly as received so a yield estimate can be replayed.

Silver.long: Fields, parcels, equipment and contracts resolved into single entities across FMIS, ERP and trading systems.

Gold.long: Contracted products agronomy and finance run on: yield per acre, input cost per bushel, basis and carbon intensity scores.

industries.label: AgTech
industries.blurb: Agriculture technology vendors: precision-ag platforms, farm-management software, equipment telematics, satellite and sensor networks, crop-science R&D, and sustainability programs.

Bronze.long: Machine telemetry off the CAN bus, satellite and drone imagery tiles, weather-station and soil-probe readings, agronomy trial and lab results, and FMS field boundaries landed exactly as received, so a yield map or a spray pass can always be replayed as it stood.

Silver.long: Fields, growers, crops, seasons and machines resolved into single conformed entities across the FMS, telematics, imagery and agronomy estates, with field boundaries reconciled to a common geometry and trial plots stitched to their protocols.

Gold.long: Contracted products the agronomy, product and sustainability teams run on: yield and vegetation index by field and hybrid, variable-rate prescription performance, machine uptime and utilisation, and verified carbon and practice-change outcomes by supply shed.

cnh-afs.t: Case IH Advanced Farming Systems (AFS Connect)

industries.label: Apparel & Fashion
industries.blurb: Seasonal collections, omnichannel retail, demand sensing, and sustainable sourcing across design, manufacturing, and direct-to-consumer channels.

Bronze.long: POS, e-commerce, PLM and factory WIP events landed exactly as received so a markdown or a allocation can be replayed.

Silver.long: Styles, SKUs, stores and digital channels resolved into single entities across ERP, PLM and commerce platforms.

Gold.long: Contracted products merchandising and finance run on: sell-through rate, full-price sell-through, OTB and margin by collection.
